entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure to establish a new PDU session with a DN, perform handover between 3GPP and non-3GPP access, transfer existing PDN connections from EPS to 5GS, establish MA PDU session for ATSSS, or relay service for 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: UE located outside LADN service area
entities.description: Condition where UE is outside the service area of a Local Area Data Network.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status activated
entities.description: Condition where UE's 3GPP packet switched data off status is activated and UE is not using exempt services.

entities.name: NB-N1 mode with user plane CIoT 5GS optimization and max user-plane resources
entities.description: Condition where UE is in NB-N1 mode, user plane CIoT 5GS optimization is accepted, and number of PDU sessions with user-plane resources equals maximum supported.

entities.name: Control plane only indication IE received
entities.description: Condition where Control plane only indication IE was received in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Control plane only indication IE
entities.description: Information element indicating control plane only operation for CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT
entities.description: Network message accepting PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: PDU session enables PDU exchange
entities.description: Property where accepted PDU session enables exchange of PDUs between UE and DN.

relations.description: Successful procedure execution establishes PDU session enabling PDU exchange between UE and DN.
Procedure shall not be requested when UE is outside LADN service area.
Procedure shall not be requested when 3GPP PS data off is activated and no exempt services are used.
Procedure shall not be requested in NB-N1 mode with user plane CIoT optimization and maximum user-plane resources reached.
Procedure shall not be requested when control plane only indication IE was received.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message may contain Control plane only indication IE.
Condition depends on reception of Control plane only indication IE.
